subject: pipeline cache: pack never shipped, generic Mali compile uncached since 4462135
body: ROOT CAUSE c6g/c6h UI slowness: (1) pack=refused = PipelinePack.tpcpack absent from Nord2Metal.bundle (nothing in link/package ever produced one; attach now returns -2 -> logs pack=absent). (2) fixed_frag_lph_cph: 54 (c6hc) / 68 (c6gc) distinct function-constant sets x ~740 ms AIR translate = 40.0 s / 52.8 s of 41.0 / 53.7 s PSO_MISS time; keys share 0 entries across builds (build id is in every key). (3) REGRESSION 4462135: tegu_render_compile_generic_options calls tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options directly, bypassing the pipeline cache (TEGU_PERF_PSO mali_ms=0 in UI logs, compile_ms>air_ms), so even warm boots recompile every generic Mali pair; HEAD fails its own cache host test (memory+disk+miss>=CASES*2). FIX in my files (not render owner files): pipeline_cache_frontend.inc adds tegu_pc_mali_generic_options (entry 11, key = both modules + both spec tables + options struct, varyings stored behind plan); render_pipeline.inc tegu_render_compile_generic_options now calls it (2 call sites, same signature/outputs). Host: cold 1192 ms -> warm 65-95 ms for 4 pipelines, byte-identical digests; pack path 79 ms; arm64 -fsyntax-only -Werror OK. Hashes: pipeline_cache_frontend.inc 373e8e9d6a45 render_pipeline.inc 80c573a75696 pipeline_cache.c c5ca3f7093a6 make_pipeline_pack.py 7eb5ddd30d1c package_metal_addon.py 5ca4697c6b74 link_metal_bundle.py 36653ca71dad build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh 545f98840711. Packer: make_pipeline_pack.py --bundle reads build id from Nord2Metal Mach-O; package_metal_addon.py --pipeline-pack validates tag and refuses stale packs; link_metal_bundle drops stale pack. Opt-in NORD2_PIPELINE_CACHE_SCOPE=compilers narrows build id to compiler archives+headers+cache sources so render-only edits keep device cache. A pre-warmed pack needs a device cache pull (k*.tpc) of the SAME build: not done, no device access. Note: host cache test case 1 (RT1 written) is refused by current true-MRT policy; test now tolerates refusal. Ledger: gpu/build/pipeline-cache-20261026/hardware-miss-ledger.json; tool gpu/tools/pipeline_cache_report.py.
